title: Can ‘eSUV’ e-bikes really go from trail to town?
summary: The article tests a new category of "electric SUV" e-bikes designed to handle both urban commuting and off-road terrain through all-terrain tires, dual suspension, and practical accessories. The author evaluated an Amflow TL Carbon e-bike, equipped with powerful Avinox motors from DJI, across a month of real-world use in Amsterdam including a three-day bikepacking trip.
content:
Have you ever wanted an electric bike that easily transitions from the drudgery of urban asphalt to adventures in gravel and dirt? That's what a subclass of so-called "electric SUV" (eSUV) e-bikes claims to do, with their wide, all-terrain tires and front and rear suspension, plus practical accessories like fenders and racks.
So, that's what I set out to test on a new TL Carbon e-bike from Amflow, the DJI offshoot that upended the mountain bike industry a few years ago with its incredibly small and powerful Avinox motors.

zh.title: "eSUV"电动自行车真的能从越野路到城镇吗?
zh.summary: 这篇文章测试了一类新型"电动越野自行车"，其设计用于通过全地形轮胎、双悬架和实用配件处理城市通勤和越野地形。作者在阿姆斯特丹进行了为期一个月的真实使用评估，测试了一款配备DJI强大Avinox电机的Amflow TL Carbon电动自行车，包括一次三天的自行车露营旅行。

title: At Meta Connect, the company’s smart glasses were everywhere
summary: Meta showcased its growing lineup of smart glasses products at the company's developer conference, emphasizing wearable technology as a key platform for consumer engagement. The demonstration highlights Meta's strategic focus on connecting users to digital experiences through eyewear devices.
content: The company behind Facebook and Instagram wants to keep consumers connected to the digital world via its ever-growing line of smart glasses.

zh.title: Meta Connect上，该公司的智能眼镜无处不在
zh.summary: Meta在公司开发者大会上展示了不断增长的智能眼镜产品线，强调可穿戴技术是消费者参与的关键平台。此次展示突出了Meta通过眼镜设备将用户连接到数字体验的战略重点。
